killedBy: the committed baselines carry roles and accessible names (issue #937) records the new-campaign confirm as a modal alertdialog, named and described by its own text
why: The committed new-campaign confirm reads role="dialog" instead of "alertdialog". The two are announced differently: an alertdialog tells a screen reader the content is urgent and reads its description at once, which is what a confirm that discards a campaign needs. The screens gate compares a capture against whatever was last accepted, so an accept can bless this loss as easily as a moved box; this test makes the loss take a test edit too.
